text: {"assertions":["On 2026-07-25, a flapping flag issue was fixed in platform/featureflags/eval.go.","A flapping flag is a decision that alternates between successive calls in the flag evaluator.","The flapping flag issue only manifested for jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary.","An error swallowed by a bare except handler was the root cause of the flapping flag issue.","The fix narrowed the exception handler to allow the failure to propagate, implemented in PR #3340 on branch fix/flapping-flag-1.","The flapping flag issue could be reproduced by evaluating the same flag for one user repeatedly.","After the fix, job execution time improved from 4 hours to 85 minutes."]}
